name: Character IP-Adapter (identity lock)
description: THE FOUR SEASONS character generation. Locks face and art style to a base-ai reference image via IP-Adapter (golden rule #1: never rely on text prompt alone for an existing character). SD1.5 only (the IP-Adapter and ControlNet models are sd15): use ckpt 'Counterfeit-V3.0_fix_fp16.safetensors' for anime/pixel work, 'dreamshaper_8.safetensors' for the semi-realistic 3D-render look of the confirmed design sheets. Sampler is pinned to euler_ancestral/karras. Required overrides: prompt, ckpt, character_ref, ip_weight, filename_prefix (plus negative_prompt in practice - if omitted it falls back to the weak global default 'text, watermark').

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, missing limbs, extra limbs, cropped, text, watermark, signature, jpeg artifacts, blurry
